policy: 480P verification slice first (efficiency law): five near-static takes re-rolled with a new seed, identical prompts, to restore motion. Never production output.
gate: mv_stability_gate.py freezes=0 required before any 768P re-burn

units.i2v_prompt: Wide shot of the dusk sky. The raised arm holds its silhouette against the darkening sky, the single index finger tracing slowly toward the first bright star low on the horizon. The gold horizon line dims by degrees. The star holds its point with a gentle twinkle. The camera tilts up in one slow unbroken ascent, easing in and settling on the star. Preserve the film grain and the original color palette.
units.note: 词窗 110-120s 黄昏第一颗星·外化锚=嘴型跟着数（侧影不显·以指循星代位）·s20143 扇形指裁决格·单臂单指保持=帧检位·A1定式槽FIX已承（B3 verdict 72词稿 r1017）
units.reburn_why: stability gate (D-20261024-05): source take is near-static for 0.3-0.7s stretches; same prompt, new seed, to get motion back

units.i2v_prompt: Locked-off tripod medium shot. The girl draws the cassette from the player and turns it over in both hands, thumb finding the far side, and seats it back with a small press; the two of them lean a fraction closer into the shared earphone cord, the single warm lamp holding its pool between them, dust motes crossing the light. The camera holds still. Preserve the film grain and the original color palette.
